description: Log workouts with exercise, sets, reps and weight; browse your training history.

faqs.a: Pick the date, enter the exercise name, sets, reps and weight, then click Log Set.
faqs.q: How do I log a workout?

faqs.a: Each entry is one exercise with its sets/reps/weight. Add one entry per exercise you do.
The history lists every entry newest-first, with volume (sets × reps × weight) computed per entry.
In this browser's localStorage — private to this device.

howto: Enter the date, exercise, sets, reps and weight.
Click Log Set — repeat for each exercise.
Review your history newest-first with per-entry volume.
Delete entries you logged by mistake.
title: Workout Log
